checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Demo changes from messy list to organized plan
must.why: Sticky-note phone becomes timed checklist; the middle shows a zoom with garbled text, but the transition works.
Blue and white throughout; the start has pastel sticky notes, but the overall look is calm.
Large, crisp 'ClearDay' logo and tagline in the last frame.
Audio can't be checked from frames; the request was for no sound.

faults.what: The start screen text is illegible scribble, and the messy list has no readable 'dentist??' or 'groceries' as claimed.
Mid-transition frame shows garbled text ('Fhish raport', 'Grocaries', 'Coll mom'), and '13:00' is distorted.
The phone header reads 'Cirlnos' and 'Clinos' (gibberish), and the icons are warped. This persists to the end frame.
The messy-list frame has no crossed-out tasks, and the sticky notes cover the whole screen. The transition is a morph and zoom, not a true sort.

summary: The ad goes from a sticky-note phone to a clean timed plan and ends on a crisp ClearDay logo and tagline, with only small garbled text on the phone screen.
